segments.ja436:1.1: Kuto nu āgacchatha bho tayo janā, svāgatā etha [svāgataṃ ettha (sī. pī.)] nisīdathāsane;
segments.ja436:1.3: Kaccittha bhonto kusalaṃ anāmayaṃ, cirassamabbhāgamanaṃ hi vo idha.
segments.ja436:2.1: Ahameva eko idha majja patto, na cāpi me dutiyo koci vijjati;
segments.ja436:2.3: Kimeva sandhāya te bhāsitaṃ ise,“kuto nu āgacchatha bho tayo janā”.
segments.ja436:3.1: Tuvañca eko bhariyā ca te piyā, samuggapakkhittanikiṇṇamantare;
segments.ja436:3.3: Sā rakkhitā kucchigatāva [kucchigatā ca (ka.)] te sadā, vāyussa [harissa (ka.)] puttena sahā tahiṃ ratā.
segments.ja436:4.1: Saṃviggarūpo isinā viyākato [pabyākato (ka.), byākato (syā. pī.)], so dānavo tattha samuggamuggili;
segments.ja436:4.3: Addakkhi bhariyaṃ suci māladhāriniṃ, vāyussa puttena sahā tahiṃ rataṃ.
segments.ja436:5.1: Sudiṭṭharūpamuggatapānuvattinā [sudiṭṭharūpuggatapānuvattinā (sī. syā. pī.)], hīnā narā ye pamadāvasaṃ gatā;
segments.ja436:5.3: Yathā have pāṇarivettha rakkhitā, duṭṭhā mayī aññamabhippamodayi.
segments.ja436:6.1: Divā ca ratto ca mayā upaṭṭhitā, tapassinā jotirivā vane vasaṃ;
segments.ja436:6.3: Sā dhammamukkamma adhammamācari, akiriyarūpo pamadāhi santhavo.
segments.ja436:7.1: Sarīramajjhamhi ṭhitātimaññahaṃ, mayhaṃ ayanti asatiṃ asaññataṃ;
segments.ja436:7.3: Sā dhammamukkamma adhammamācari, akiriyarūpo pamadāhi santhavo.
segments.ja436:8.1: Surakkhitaṃ meti kathaṃ nu vissase, anekacittāsu na hatthi [anekacittā puna hettha (ka.)] rakkhaṇā;
segments.ja436:8.3: Etā hi pātālapapātasannibhā, etthappamatto byasanaṃ nigacchati.
segments.ja436:9.1: Tasmā hi te sukhino vītasokā, ye mātugāmehi caranti nissaṭā;
segments.ja436:9.3: Etaṃ sivaṃ uttamamābhipatthayaṃ, na mātugāmehi kareyya santhavanti.
